What is the EEA USA Corps
This is not a program.
It is a movement.
The EEA USA Corps is a national youth leadership and workforce development initiative through Edwards Education Academy of America. We recruit, train, and deploy young people between the ages of 12 and 26 who are ready to lead in four dimensions: civil, social, economic, and entrepreneurial. Corps members do not just learn about leadership; they practice it inside their own communities, building the skills and the track record that defines the next generation of American changemakers.
Four Dimensions of Corps Leadership
The Skills You Will Lead With
01
Civic Life
Civil Leadership
Understand how systems work, how policy is made, and how to advocate effectively for your community at every level of civic life.
02
Community
Social Leadership
Build relationships, mobilize people, and lead with cultural intelligence in spaces that reflect the full diversity of American life.
03
Financial Literacy
Economic Leadership
Develop financial literacy, workforce readiness, and a working understanding of how economic systems shape the communities we live in.
04
Business Building
Entrepreneurship
Learn to identify opportunity, build something from nothing, and develop the entrepreneurial mindset that creates jobs and generational wealth.

Who Should Apply
You belong in the Corps if…
You are between the ages of 12 and 26
You want to lead civically and understand how systems work
You are ready to build social and community influence
You want real economic skills and workforce experience
You have an entrepreneurial spirit and want to build something
You believe your community deserves your best leadership
